writeups: ventures/systemd-unit-hardening-check/README.md (How it is checked: against systemd itself)
notes: Explore idea: differential-test systemd-unit-hardening-check against systemd's own parser (systemd-analyze security --offline=yes --json=short, systemd 255.4 in the container, ~8 ms/unit). Ten finding types mapped to its tests. Baseline 1,455 of 3,797 loadable trees disagreed (seed 101). Fixed in both twins: invalid assignments ignored with earlier value standing (finding names the ignored line), case-sensitive ProtectSystem/ProtectHome words (ProtectSystem=Strict was reported protected), y/t/n/f booleans, fatal DynamicUser= ending a drop-in, [ Service ] not Service, list-mode semantics for lone ~ and none. Held-out seeds 101-105: 63 of 19,082 differ, all deny lists of unknown names (documented gap, classified only when systemd warned). Developed on seeds 1-5. node tests 38 pass, unittest OK.

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
